result:
I've written the round-507 task. Decision: **CONTINUE**. Round 506 passed C's browser check with no bugs, and the gate published it at `3021b30`, which is the starting point for round 507.

**Round 507: the global audio player's buttons move onto the shared icon button**
- **What changes:** the four icon buttons in the Store's bottom player (Close, Previous, Next, Mute/Unmute) switch to the shared `IconButton`, in its plain "ghost" style. Close gets smaller (34 → 32 px) and the other three slightly larger (36 → 40 px). The circles become rounded squares, the transport icons are dimmed at rest so Play stands out, and Close no longer turns red on hover. The last hardcoded white hover colour in the player is gone.
- **How it's prepared:** as in earlier rounds, I wrote the exact patch for A to apply.
  - The tech-lead approved it with Low conditions only, all fixed or ruled.
  - The full test suite passes on it (304 files, 4,384 tests), and so does the build.
  - The new tests fail when I deliberately break the code (7 of 7 checks), so they really test something.
  - I compared the old and new player in a real browser at 1440, 1280 and 375 px wide, with a real preview playing.
- **What C checks:** sizes, colours, hover and press, the keyboard focus ring, contrast (7.2:1), the layout, and real playback (Mute sets volume to 0, Unmute back to 0.7, Close stops it). C also checks that anonymous visitors still see "Sign in required" on purchased pages and that `/studio-lab` still opens.
- **Layout:** nothing moves at 1440 and 1280. At 375 the player gets 4 px taller, because Mute sits on its own row there.

**The wider button cleanup.** A new scan found 58 hand-styled controls in 29 files; with the LeadMagnet popup's Close X that makes 59. The product designer ruled on each one: 16 move to the shared button, 13 to the icon button, 28 stay as they are (menus, tabs, selectable cards and similar), and 2 are in a protected file, so they go to root. They are split into stages N1–N9. Round 507 is N1.

**Found while planning (none of these is caused by round 507):**
- **Medium bug, `B-R507-SIDEBAR-FREE-DOWNLOAD-DEAD`:** on a free product's page, "Complimentary Download" does nothing. It has had no click action since 2026-03-08. It is planned as round 508, ahead of more cleanup stages, because fixing it needs a decision on where the button should lead. It also needs a free product in the mock data to test in the browser.
- **Two Low bugs, deferred:**
  - closing the player with the keyboard drops focus to the page body;
  - the Close button's focus ring is cut off at the screen's right edge.
- **Root request, `ROOT-REQ-MOCK-STEMS-AND-FREE-FIXTURE`:** the Stems player window can't be opened in the cloud, because no mock product has stems, so its two buttons wait. I asked root to add a product with stems and a free product. I haven't yet tried faking that data during in-page navigation; I'll try it when planning round 508, and it might make the request unnecessary.

**Questions for Saba** (`user-review/questions-round-507.md`; none blocks, defaults apply):
- player icons as rounded squares or circles (default: rounded squares);
- equal weight for the cookie banner's Accept and Decline (default: equal);
- whether to add an outline button style (default: no).

The advisor was available; I consulted it after orientation and again before closing. Its second review led to the two Low bugs above, more complete evidence checks, and an extra line telling Saba about the dimmed icons and the smaller, no-longer-red Close button. No architecture checkpoint is requested: this is one owner and a straight component swap. A regression round is due on or after 2026-11-16, and the next retrospective is at round 510. The store worktree is clean and no app code was changed.
